title: Maneuvering thruster definition
description:
AGENTS: before modifying this schema, read AGENTS.md at the repository root.

Defines a maneuvering thruster (RCS) configuration that can be referenced by ship templates. Physical quantities follow ADR-0008 (value+unit objects). Allowed units are defined in the central units registry (assets/json/schema/units.schema.json).

The thruster name is the directory name under assets/components/propulsion/maneuvering-thrusters/ — no `id` field is needed.

type.description: Maneuvering thruster type. Determines response characteristics in M3+.

max_torque.description: Maximum torque in Newton-meters applied around each rotation axis (pitch=X, yaw=Y, roll=Z per ADR-0006).

max_strafe_thrust.description: Maximum strafe thrust in Newtons applied along each lateral/vertical axis (left/right=X, up/down=Y). Same value for all strafe directions.

rotation_ramp_ticks.description: Number of ticks for torque to ramp from 0% to 100% when a rotation key is first pressed. 0 = instant full torque (no ramp). Default 60.
